gen-gf-sniglet-gf-actor: Actor reads wide and modern, its s curves barely curling in on themselves. Sniglet is the one with presence, its terminals stopping short and every stroke the same weight; Actor does the quiet work.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-akatab: Distinctive and commanding, Sniglet cuts every letter like vinyl at a single line width. Akatab's round, cupped letters make a plain sans that stays approachable and never feels clenched over a full page.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-alan-sans: Sniglet looks marker-drawn, with terminals that stop short of curling back in and no swing in weight anywhere. Then Alan Sans follows, its curve tails held well back from the body, and a modest size jump would be plenty.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-albert-sans: Albert Sans keeps its apertures open even at tiny sizes, and its strokes hold one thickness whichever way they run. Albert Sans over a long page feels contemporary and steady, a sans-serif that never fusses under Sniglet's display voice.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-alef: Alef reads modern and clean, with open-ended curves running all the way through it. Over a longer passage that openness keeps the plain sans easy on the eye, while Sniglet's terminals end exactly as wide as they began.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Sniglet draws every stroke at one weight, a display face with a marker-like plainness. Alegreya Sans SC is the one that handles the reading, its welcoming gap in the c making it a plain sans you settle into.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-almarai: Terminals that stop short of curling back give Sniglet its blunt, commanding look, with no accents of weight. Almarai follows with a sans-serif line that never swells or tapers, and letters that never seem to pinch shut.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-amarna: Contemporary and clean, Amarna keeps its strokes contrast-free from stem to terminal. Across a longer passage its small counters stay unclogged, a sans that gives Sniglet's display swagger something quiet to lean against.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-andika: Andika makes its tails and terminals as thick as the main stems, with s shapes that take wide, easy turns. Sniglet sits above as the display voice, distinctive and level, and Andika, a sans, carries the rest.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-anta: Wire-bent and sign-like, Anta holds constant thickness and gapes wide on the e. And Sniglet, with terminals that stop short of curling back, makes the sturdier partner, commanding up top while Anta stays approachable.
